name: loader-tittle
title: Tittle loader
description: The youj o, built in particles and given depth, turns and lands while the j’s square tittle orbits it in the accent, passing behind the letter and through its counter. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.
